counterexample: For a 5-vertex path, start at an endpoint vi. The large component C has size 4. After moving to its neighbor vi+1, the component containing vi has size 1 = 5-4, not 5-4-1 = 0.
assessment_summary: Line 0054 miscounts the component formed after moving from vi to vi+1. If the previous large component has size s, the component on the vi side contains vi and every vertex outside that large component, so its size is n-s, not n-s-1. Thus the stated equality, and consequently the bound in line 0055, is false.
